about.title: About Mehdi Sedighi
about.lead: Clinician-manager and founder of Owj Academy.
about.body: 15 years as a clinician and manager of Isfahan's largest physiotherapy and corrective-exercise center, former physiotherapist of the Sepahan team. Today I help clinic owners build a clinic that runs profitably and independently — even without their constant presence — through systems, sales training and team leadership. I speak from the field, not from a book.
